thread:
sarah_onsite: Paging on /v1/generate — multiple customer reports of 504s and very high error rates starting ~22:07 UTC. Seeing spike in 5xxs across both hosted and dedicated routes. @incident-bot any alerts?
incident-bot: Alert 8472 triggered: upstream_error_rate > 8% for service=runtime-generator (22:07 UTC). Auto-paging to #incidents.
aj: I’m on it, grabbing logs now. Do we have a specific customer calling this out?
sarah_onsite: Yes — AcmeCorp sent a support ticket, they hit timeouts during a live demo. Their traffic is small but they’re hitting errors on every request. Link to ticket: https://support.example.com/t/ACME-1122
mike_sre: Looking at ingress gateways — 502s from runtime-01 and 03, stacks show repeated KV cache misses and tokenization exceptions in the runtime logs. Pasting tail: ```
[22:06:58] runtime-01 ERR tokenization: "invalid_bpe_sequence"
[22:07:01] runtime-03 WARN kvcache miss for prefix id=0x5a3
[22:07:05] runtime-01 ERR inference: upstream error: model kernel crash (SIGSEGV)```
laura_pm: Confirming customer impact: AcmeCorp demo in progress, potential revenue / renewal risk. Need direct comms if this persists.
nina_eng: I can repro locally with a small harness — looks like quantized kernel path failing on sequence lengths > 2048. Sending a quick patch to disable that kernel for affected variants.
ops_manager: Can we fallback traffic to smaller model variants while we patch? Need to keep SLA.
mike_sre: Yes, we have a compatible fallback (gpt-neo-lite) in the model catalog. I’ll run a canary route: `route set runtime-generator -> fallback:gpt-neo-lite percent=20` then shift to 100% if stable.
aj: I’ll coordinate the rollout and monitor error rate. Rolling to 20% now.
incident-bot: Change 2921: traffic split updated — gpt-neo-lite at 20% for tenant-wide route (aj).
kelly_support: Reached out to AcmeCorp CSM with a brief note: we’ve detected an infrastructure issue and are routing them to a safe variant. Will update every 15m.
sarah_onsite: Thanks. Keep the customer looped. Any ETA on a fix?
nina_eng: Patch ready, running unit + smoke on a node. If green, can push to staging in ~18 mins, production in ~40. Need SRE to coordinate deploy window.
mike_sre: I’ll prepare a canary deploy job. Also increasing node pool on dedicated to drain pressure: `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-pool --replicas=8`. Doing now.
aj: Error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% after the 20% fallback and scale up. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Metric update: upstream_error_rate=2.9% (22:35 UTC).
sarah_onsite: Good. Let’s prepare an RCA and schedule a postmortem. Who owns?
laura_pm: I’ll own the postmortem logistics and customer impact section. Suggest we do a synchronous RCA doc and 1-hour postmortem meeting tomorrow. Proposed attendees: SRE, Eng runtime, Eng ML, Product, Support.
nina_eng: I’ll draft the technical timeline and contributing factors. Assign to me to create the RCA draft by EOD tomorrow.
mike_sre: I’ll add operational mitigations and the rollout timeline.
ops_manager: Action item: create runbook task to disable faulty kernel variant on deploy if crash signatures seen. Owner: ops_manager. Due: 2024-11-05.
kelly_support: Action item: send customer follow-up post-incident with impact summary and mitigation. Owner: kelly_support. Due: 2024-11-04.
laura_pm: Scheduling: postmortem meeting Thu 09:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent. Agenda: timeline, contributing factors, action items, communication plan.
aj: Add note: we should include cost/regression tradeoffs for fallback routing — it increases token latency for some flows.
sarah_onsite: Draft RCA needs: incident timeline (from pager), detection method, immediate mitigations, root cause hypothesis, long-term fix, customer impact, follow-ups + owners.
nina_eng: Drafting timeline now: root cause appears to be a regression in the quantized attention kernel introduced in commit 0f9c3b7 (ML infra) that only surfaces with certain tokenization outputs. Repro steps included in the doc.
mike_sre: Peer review request: @aj @sarah_onsite please review the mitigations section once I put it in. I’ll aim to have my section up in ~4 hours.
aj: ACK — will review.
laura_pm: For sign-off: tech leads + SRE + product manager must approve the RCA text. Then CS will send the final customer note. Deadline for sign-off: Fri 17:00 UTC.
ops_manager: Noting a follow-up: add an integration test to our CI that fuzzes tokenization across quantized kernels to catch this earlier. Owner: ops_manager. Due: 2024-12-01.
kelly_support: Also logging impact for billing/credits — we may offer an SLA credit if thresholds met. I’ll calculate after final metrics.
incident-bot: Postmortem created: PMT-2024-11-03-8472 by laura_pm. Link: https://pm.example.com/PMT-8472
laura_pm: RCA draft link posted to the doc: https://docs.example.com/rca/PMT-8472 — please add comments inline.
sarah_onsite: Quick note for RFC: consider a safety policy to auto-fallback when kernel crash signatures detected without human confirmation. We had manual steps that cost minutes.
nina_eng: Good point — adding design note to RCA for an automated fallback circuit.
mike_sre: Final note — can we add a short post-release verification step for quantized kernels? A smoke run against a fixed token set pre-deploy. If it fails, block rollout. Adding to action items. Owner: mike_sre. Due: 2024-11-10.
laura_pm: Thanks team. I’ll collect owners and deadlines in the RCA and ping for review. Meeting invite has recording for those who can’t make it.
sarah_onsite: Closing the incident thread; we’re in mitigation and have follow-ups assigned. If anything regresses reopen with pager. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident 8472 status changed to mitigated (22:58 UTC).
